name: OUC Resume LaTeX
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y texlive-xetex texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-fonts-extra texlive-lang-chinese make
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p fonts/hansans fonts/Main && curl -fsSL -o fonts/hansans/NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maksymilan/zju-resume-template/master/fonts/hansans/NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf && curl -fsSL -o fonts/hansans/NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maksymilan/zju-resume-template/master/fonts/hansans/NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf && curl -fsSL -o fonts/Main/texgyretermes-regular.otf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maksymilan/zju-resume-template/master/fonts/Main/texgyretermes-regular.otf && curl -fsSL -o fonts/Main/texgyretermes-bold.otf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maksymilan/zju-resume-template/master/fonts/Main/texgyretermes-bold.otf && echo 'LaTeX environment is ready! Run make to build.'
